name: Bar Editor
author: David JM
description: Visual editor for the Omarchy bar: layout widgets across the left/center/right sections, bar position and transparency, idle timeouts, [bar] styling in shell.toml, and plugins.

barWidget.description: One bar icon that opens a full-screen editor for the bar layout, settings, styling, idle timeouts, and plugins. Changes are saved to ~/.config/omarchy/shell.json and shell.toml and hot-reloaded by the shell.
